title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of State Security on Several Issues concerning Release on Bail Pending Trial
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate,

Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of State Security

Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Execution of Bail Pending Trial

Gongtongzi [1999] No. 59

Article 1 These Provisions are formulated in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Law and relevant legal provisions, for the purpose of strictly implementing the Criminal Procedure Law and ensuring the correct application of bail pending trial.

Article 2 The decision to grant bail pending trial to a criminal suspect or defendant shall be made by the public security organ, state security organ, people's procuratorate, or people's court according to the specific circumstances of the case and in accordance with the law.

Where the public security organ, people's procuratorate, or people's court decides to grant bail pending trial, it shall be executed by the public security organ. Where the state security organ decides to grant bail pending trial, or where the people's procuratorate or people's court decides to grant bail pending trial in handling a criminal case transferred by the state security organ, it shall be executed by the state security organ.

Article 3 Where a decision to grant bail pending trial is made for a criminal suspect or defendant, the investigation, prosecution, and trial of the case shall not be suspended. It is strictly prohibited to use bail pending trial as a disguised means of indulging criminal conduct.

Article 4 Where a decision to grant bail pending trial is made for a criminal suspect or defendant, the deciding organ shall order him to provide a surety or to deposit a guaranty.

For the same criminal suspect or defendant, where a decision to grant bail pending trial is made, both a surety and a deposit of guaranty shall not be used simultaneously.

Article 5 Where bail pending trial is adopted in the form of a deposit of guaranty, the minimum amount of the guaranty is one thousand yuan.

The deciding organ shall determine the amount of the guaranty to be collected based on the principle of ensuring that the person released on bail pending trial does not evade or obstruct criminal proceedings, and by comprehensively considering the social dangerousness of the criminal suspect or defendant, the circumstances and nature of the case, the likely severity of the punishment, the financial situation of the criminal suspect or defendant, and the local level of economic development.

Article 6 The deposit of guaranty for bail pending trial shall be uniformly collected and managed by the executing organ at or above the county level. Decisions to confiscate the guaranty, decisions to return the guaranty, and decisions to impose a fine on the surety shall be made by the executing organ at or above the county level.

Article 7 The executing organ at or above the county level shall establish a special account for depositing the guaranty for bail pending trial in a designated bank, and entrust the bank to collect and hold the guaranty on its behalf, and shall notify the people's procuratorate and the people's court of the name of the designated bank.

The guaranty shall be deposited in Renminbi.

Article 8 After the deciding organ makes a decision to collect a guaranty for bail pending trial, it shall promptly serve the "Decision on Bail Pending Trial" on the person released on bail pending trial and the unit or individual providing the guaranty on his behalf, and order him to deposit the full amount of the guaranty in one lump sum with the bank designated by the executing organ.

After verifying the evidence that the guaranty has been deposited in the bank designated by the executing organ, the deciding organ shall submit the "Decision on Bail Pending Trial", the "Notice of Execution of Bail Pending Trial", the documentary receipt issued by the bank, and other relevant materials together to the executing organ for execution.

Article 9 When executing the bail pending trial, the executing organ shall inform the person released on bail pending trial that he must comply with the provisions of Article 56 of the Criminal Procedure Law, and inform him of the consequences of violating those provisions or of committing a new crime during the period of bail pending trial.

Article 10 Where the person released on bail pending trial violates the provisions of Article 56 of the Criminal Procedure Law, and the guaranty should be confiscated according to law, the executing organ at or above the county level shall make a decision to confiscate part or all of the guaranty, and notify the deciding organ; where it is necessary to change the coercive measures, it shall simultaneously provide its opinion on changing the coercive measures, together with the relevant materials, to the deciding organ.

Article 11 Where the deciding organ discovers that the person released on bail pending trial has violated the provisions of Article 56 of the Criminal Procedure Law, and considers that the guaranty should be confiscated according to law, it shall submit a written opinion on confiscating part or all of the guaranty, together with the relevant materials, to the executing organ at or above the county level. The executing organ at or above the county level shall, based on the opinion of the deciding organ, promptly make a decision to confiscate the guaranty, and notify the deciding organ.

Article 12 Where the person released on bail pending trial has not violated the provisions of Article 56 of the Criminal Procedure Law, but is suspected of committing a new crime during the period of bail pending trial and is placed on file for investigation by the judicial organs, the executing organ shall temporarily withhold the guaranty deposited, and shall decide whether to confiscate the guaranty after the people's court's judgment takes effect. For a new crime committed intentionally, the guaranty shall be confiscated; for a new crime committed negligently or where the act does not constitute a crime, the guaranty shall be returned.

Article 13 After receiving a written notice from the executing organ that the guaranty has been confiscated, or an opinion on changing coercive measures, the deciding organ shall, within five days, make a decision to change the coercive measures or to order the criminal suspect or defendant to deposit a new guaranty or provide a surety, and notify the executing organ.

The procedures for deciding to deposit a new guaranty shall be governed by the relevant provisions of these Provisions.

Article 14 The executing organ shall announce to the person released on bail pending trial the decision to confiscate the guaranty, and inform him that if he is dissatisfied with this decision, he may, within five days after receiving the "Decision on Confiscating the Guaranty", apply for one review to the competent authority at the next higher level of the executing organ. After receiving the application for review, the competent authority at the next higher level shall make a review decision within seven days.

Article 15 Where the period for applying for review of the decision to confiscate the guaranty has expired or, after review, the decision to confiscate the guaranty is upheld, the executing organ at or above the county level shall promptly notify the bank to turn over the guaranty to the state treasury in accordance with the relevant regulations of the state.

Article 16 Where bail pending trial is adopted in the form of a surety, and the person released on bail pending trial violates the provisions of Article 56 of the Criminal Procedure Law, and the surety fails to report in a timely manner, after verification, the executing organ at or above the county level shall impose a fine of not less than one thousand yuan but not more than twenty thousand yuan on the surety, and promptly notify the deciding organ of the relevant circumstances.

Article 17 The executing organ shall announce to the surety the decision to impose a fine, and inform him that if he is dissatisfied with this decision, he may, within five days after receiving the "Decision on Imposing a Fine on the Surety", apply for one review to the competent authority at the next higher level of the executing organ. After receiving the application for review, the competent authority at the next higher level shall make a review decision within seven days.

Article 18 Both the confiscation of the guaranty for bail pending trial and the imposition of a fine on the surety are criminal judicial acts and are not subject to administrative litigation. If a party is dissatisfied with the review decision, he may file a petition with the relevant authorities in accordance with the law.

Article 19 Where bail pending trial is adopted in the form of a surety, and the executing organ discovers that the surety has lost the qualification to act as a surety, it shall notify the deciding organ in writing.

After receiving the written notice from the executing organ, the deciding organ shall order the person released on bail pending trial to provide a new surety or to deposit a guaranty, or make a decision to change the coercive measures, and notify the executing organ.

Article 20 Where the period of bail pending trial is about to expire, the executing organ shall, fifteen days before the expiration of the period, notify the deciding organ in writing. The deciding organ shall make a decision to lift the bail pending trial or to change the coercive measures, and notify the executing organ in writing before the expiration of the period.

After receiving the "Decision on Lifting Bail Pending Trial" or the notice of changing coercive measures from the deciding organ, the executing organ shall execute it immediately, and promptly notify the deciding organ of the execution status.

Article 21 Where the person released on bail pending trial has not violated the provisions of Article 56 of the Criminal Procedure Law during the period of bail pending trial and has not intentionally committed a new crime, at the same time as the bail pending trial is lifted, the coercive measures are changed, or a penalty is executed, the executing organ at or above the county level shall make a "Decision on Returning the Guaranty", notify the bank to return the guaranty in full, and notify the deciding organ in writing.

The executing organ shall promptly announce to the person released on bail pending trial the decision to return the guaranty, and notify him in writing to go to the bank to collect the returned guaranty.

Article 22 Where bail pending trial has already been adopted at the stage of investigation or examination and prosecution, when the case is transferred to the stage of examination and prosecution or trial, if it is necessary to continue the bail pending trial, or to change the method of guarantee or coercive measures, the receiving organ shall make a decision within seven days, and notify the executing organ and the organ that transferred the case.

Where the receiving organ decides to continue the bail pending trial, it shall make a new decision on bail pending trial. Where the bail pending trial is continued in the form of a deposit of guaranty, the amount of the guaranty shall, in principle, not be changed, and the guaranty shall not be collected anew.

Where the period of bail pending trial is about to expire, and the receiving organ has not yet made a decision to continue the bail pending trial, change the method of guarantee, or change the coercive measures, the executing organ shall, fifteen days before the expiration of the period, notify the receiving organ in writing. The receiving organ shall make a decision before the expiration of the original bail pending trial period, and notify the executing organ and the organ that transferred the case.

Article 23 After receiving the decision from the receiving organ to change the coercive measures, the original deciding organ shall immediately lift the original bail pending trial, and serve the "Decision on Lifting Bail Pending Trial" and the "Notice of Lifting Bail Pending Trial" on the executing organ, which shall promptly notify the person released on bail pending trial and the surety in writing; where the receiving organ makes a decision to continue the bail pending trial or to change the method of guarantee, the original bail pending trial shall be automatically lifted, and no further formalities for lifting need to be handled.

Article 24 Where a defendant has been granted bail pending trial and the people's court decides to open a court session for trial, it shall summon the defendant in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law, and at the same time notify the executing organ of the bail pending trial.

Article 25 Where, after a judgment imposing a fine or confiscation of property on a person released on bail pending trial takes effect, the bail pending trial should be lifted according to law and the guaranty returned, if the guaranty constitutes part of the person's personal property, the people's court may, in writing, notify the executing organ to transfer the guaranty to the people's court for execution of the penalty, but the remaining portion shall be returned to the person released on bail pending trial.

Article 26 The collection, management, and confiscation of the guaranty shall be strictly carried out in accordance with these Provisions and the state's financial management system. No unit or individual may intercept, withhold, privately distribute, misappropriate, or otherwise embezzle the guaranty.

Any person who violates these provisions shall be subject to administrative sanctions in accordance with the relevant provisions; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law.

Article 27 Where a judicial organ or its personnel violates these Provisions by collecting, confiscating, or returning the guaranty for bail pending trial without authorization, the directly responsible supervisor and other directly responsible personnel shall be held accountable in accordance with relevant laws and regulations.

Article 28 These Provisions shall take effect as of the date of promulgation.
